title: Music City Daze - Downtown Room w/ Private Entry!
description:
Experience the best of Nashville from this newly built private retreat, just 10 minutes from Nissan Stadium, Bridgestone Arena, and the Ryman. Nestled between The Nations and Germantown, this stylish hideaway features a queen bed, spa-inspired bathroom, Smart TV, Keurig, microwave, beverage fridge, & ice maker. Relax in the modern outdoor space and enjoy easy access to live music, dining, & Nashville's top attractions. Perfect city getaway blending comfort, convenience, & relaxation to recharge!

The space
Bedroom, attached private bathroom, patio, and private outdoor entrance.

Guest access
Guests have access to the bedroom and its attached bathroom, both of which are closed off from the rest of the home.

During your stay
I have a friendly large size dog on-site who stays in private quarters.

Other things to note
Early check-in and late-check out are available upon request for an extra fee. 

Cleaning / Room refresh service is available upon request for an extra fee. 

Message for availability.
